purpose: GT-last descriptive decomposition of fixed Source-T foreground-support error for already-completed immutable SW0164/SW0165 predictions

selection.rule: Always include all three seeds, irrespective of the SW0165 replication result or gate; never select only positive seeds

prerequisites.sw0165_seed0_and_seed2_stage_states: both must be complete and match their validated immutable score hashes; SW0165 gate pass is not required
prerequisites.validation_order: validate all source/candidate/Slot predictions for seeds 0,1,2 before invoking any public score validator; validate all three score reports before this diagnostic opens canonical masks

ground_truth.dataset: canonical SW0130 HDF5; exact registered validation RGB/mask rows 1320..1639
ground_truth.prediction_use: No GT used for prediction, solver input, support, or seed selection

per_image_diagnostics.support: fixed Source-T foreground support (label != 0); candidate foreground membership must exactly match it
per_image_diagnostics.actual_fg_ari: SW0135 production FG-ARI on candidate labels
per_image_diagnostics.fixed_support_ari_upper_bound: SW0165 certified relaxation; on target foreground, allow unlimited/disconnected foreground groups on covered patches and one predicted-background group for all missed foreground patches
per_image_diagnostics.missed_foreground: Count GT-foreground patches outside Source-T support and distinct GT objects with any missed patch
per_image_diagnostics.covered_pair_errors: Among covered GT-foreground patch pairs: split count is same-GT/different-predicted-label; merge count is different-GT/same-predicted-label; report eligible denominators and rates
per_image_diagnostics.forced_errors: Separately count different-GT missed/missed pairs forced together in prediction background and same-GT covered/missed pairs forced apart
per_image_diagnostics.support_idealized_attachment: Keep all covered predicted groups unchanged; assign each missed foreground patch to the covered predicted group with greatest overlap for its GT object (smallest predicted label breaks ties); if no such group exists, create one label for that GT object. This uses GT and is only an unattainable reference, not a prediction.

order: split each actual positive cluster by GT object, preserving fixed zero membership and all same-GT positive splits
then merge same-GT positive groups to the certified fixed-support upper bound
sequential_counterfactuals.interpretation: order-dependent descriptive deltas; not independent causal effects

aggregate.report: Per-seed means and fixed three-seed means; paired fixed-320 image bootstrap with common image indices across seeds
comparisons: certified upper bound vs actual candidate
aggregate.validity: Use production metric valid-count semantics; record any invalid per-image metric rather than silently changing the population
aggregate.bootstrap_method: average seeds at each common image index, then paired-resample image indices across the fixed320 board

interpretation_limits: Descriptive GT-conditioned error analysis only; it does not select seeds or change a model, prediction, threshold, or solver.
The certified upper bound relaxes connectivity and therefore need not be attainable by the registered 4-connected solver.
The support-idealized attachment uses GT and is not achievable by a GT-free predictor.
Covered-pair and forced-error counts describe this fixed dataset and do not establish causal mechanisms or generalization.

decision.fixed320_cannot_reach_0p87: three-seed fixed320 mean bound < 0.87; independent of bootstrap CI
decision.fixed320_cannot_strictly_beat_slot: three-seed fixed320 mean bound <= three-seed own-Slot FG-ARI mean; independent of bootstrap CI
decision.generalization: report each paired bootstrap CI direction separately; CI does not change fixed-board feasibility flags

output: Create-only JSON; no automatic promotion, seed selection, threshold/loss/solver changes
